items.item_text: Current, valid California Clinical Laboratory Scientist license

Join UCLA Health's West Valley Hospital as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) Generalist and play a vital role in delivering high-quality patient care through accurate and timely laboratory testing.

In this role, you will perform and interpret a wide range of moderate and high-complexity laboratory tests across multiple disciplines, including Chemistry, Hematology, Coagulation, Urinalysis, and Blood Bank. You will ensure quality standards are met, troubleshoot instrumentation, maintain regulatory compliance, and collaborate with healthcare teams to support diagnostic and treatment decisions.
Must pass the Ishihara Color Vision exam, i.e. visual acuity including color differentiation
Ability to work rotating weekends and holidays
Ability to work an alternative schedule on occasion (e.g. Tuesday – Saturday, 11:00pm – 7:30am) based on operational needs.
